scenario: Maximum segment count per LECC.1.4 — code patterns deeper than `<family>.<a>.<b>.<c>` (four segments) are forbidden. The compiler must reject `error <pattern>:` clauses whose pattern exceeds four segments. Pin: a five-segment error pattern under the `adapter` family rejects with DS_VALIDATE_ERROR_PATTERN_TOO_DEEP, and with no other code: the family is one [LECC.6.4] admits.
rules_ds:
service weather.get_forecasts:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema TimeOfDay scope ttl 1_min:
    state: String

rule daily_forecast:
    TimeOfDay t where t.state == "18:00"
->
    call weather.get_forecasts entity_id: "weather.home" cooldown: 23_h
        error adapter.failed.scope.subcategory.toodeep:
            log info "never"
